name: Waterline Card
description: A card where moving the pointer across it pulls a glowing waterline, and the text behind the line reads differently.

props.name: text
props.description: Text shown at rest, in a muted tone.

props.name: revealText
props.description: Text shown to the left of the line, in a water-to-snow gradient (water to ink in the light theme). Screen readers hear both texts.

props.name: children
props.description: The title and description, placed above the text.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. The line follows a mouse, follows a drag on touch, leans with its speed and drains back to the left edge when the pointer leaves. Keyboard focus reveals the whole text. Other div props are passed through.
